_comment: Adversarial-review dispositions for the AI domain, read by tools/migration_loop.py's review_gate(). A function the manifest flags review_required (writes a roster region OR size>p90 OR is root) may not be promoted to `verified` without an entry here. Shape: "<function name>": {"disposition": "reviewed"|"exempt", "session": "<YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM>", "by": "<reimpl-verify workflow / agent>", "note": "<evidence, or why no shadow/review applies>"}. A `reviewed` entry MUST name the `session` that ran the review: the driver cross-checks that that session's captured agents (session_reports/loop/<session>/agents.json) actually include an adversarial-review spawn -- a bare `reviewed` with no spawn is rejected. An `exempt` entry needs no agent (it is an explicit human-auditable decision). Keys beginning with _ are comments. Rows verified before the gate landed (2026-08-26) carry explicit grandfather exempt entries (backfilled same day). Two layers now read this file: migration_loop.py gates the TRANSITION to verified per session and cross-checks agent backing; migration_session.py --end fails while ANY review_required+verified row lacks a disposition, so a skip is caught in-session.

llm_strat_ai_players_tick.by: wf reimpl-verify wf_2ef3fcc2-a46 (batch: players_tick + notify_unit_lifecycle, 3 reviewers + adjudicator)
llm_strat_ai_players_tick.note: Verdict `equivalent`. ONE note-severity item was raised and adjudicated as NOT a divergence: the five loop bounds are an unsigned CMP/JC in the original (0x004db985, 0x004db9b7, 0x004dba25, 0x004dba93, 0x004dbb08) against a signed `p < *v.active_player_count` in the draft -- identical for every value the field can hold ([0, MAX_PLAYERS]), and reaching a difference needs active_player_count already negative. Recorded rather than dropped. The header's own NaN/unordered-comparison choice (`!(s >= clock)` matching JNC) was reviewed and not disputed; the oracle cannot exercise it, and that limit is stated in the session report.

llm_strat_ai_notify_unit_lifecycle.by: wf reimpl-verify wf_2ef3fcc2-a46 (batch: players_tick + notify_unit_lifecycle, 3 reviewers + adjudicator)
llm_strat_ai_notify_unit_lifecycle.note: Verdict `equivalent`. ONE note-severity item, adjudicated as NOT a divergence: the draft casts uint32_t unit_id to int32_t before each roster-index computation while the original IMULs the raw 32-bit register (0x004dbb85, 0x004dbb8b) -- bit-identical on this target under two's-complement narrowing/widening, and unit_id is bounded to UNITS_PER_PLAYER anyway. Reviewers were asked specifically whether `notify_report` (added for testability) changed any control flow or any write; they found it did not.
